title: Netherlands – Accounting, auditing and fiscal services – (Heraanbesteding) Europese aanbesteding Fiscale adviesdiensten Gemeente Breda
description: Procedure Aanbesteding middels de Europees openbare procedure conform de (gewijzigde) aanbestedingswet 2012. Opdrachtgever De opdrachtgever bij deze aanbesteding is de Gemeente Breda. Voor meer informatie over de Gemeente Breda verwijzen wij u naar de website van de gemeente: www.breda.nl. Opdracht De opdracht betreft een raamovereenkomst voor integrale fiscale adviesdiensten. De fiscale adviesdiensten hebben betrekking op alle mogelijke fiscale vraagstukken bij de gemeentelijke overheid of gelieerde overheidsbedrijven of deelnemingen, waaronder in ieder geval op het gebied van: - Vennootschapsbelasting; - Omzetbelasting (incuslief BTW compensatiefonds); - Loonbelasting; - Overdrachtsbelasting. Opdrachtgever heeft een fiscaal team binnen de organisatie welke voorziet in de fiscale advisering van de organisatie. Dit team heeft de fiscale (basis) kennis in huis en zorgt voor voorbereiding van aangiften. Het doel van deze raamovereenkomst is ondersteuning van het fiscaal team op het gebied van: - Indienen aangiften vennootschapsbelasting; - Uitvoeren van een jaarlijkse steekproefrapportage; - Natuurlijke adviesfunctie: sparringpartnerfunctie in (complexe) adviesvragen; - Back up in geval van te grote werkvoorraad. Jaarlijks wordt van opdrachtnemer gevraagd om in ieder geval de aangifte vennootschapsbelasting in te dienen. Voor het overige geeft de aanbestedende dienst geen omzetgarantie. Het daadwerkelijk benodigde fiscaal advies is voor een belangrijk deel afhankelijk van politieke, economische, maatschappelijke en interne ontwikkelingen. Voor de overige werkzaamheden zal voorafgaand aan de uitvoering van de werkzaamheden de inschrijver op verzoek van de gemeente een offerte/kostenraming indienen. Percelen Deze opdracht is niet verdeeld in percelen. Maximale contractwaarde De maximale opdrachtwaarde in het kader van deze raamovereenkomst wordt gesteld op € 240.000,- bezien over de looptijd van de overeenkomst, inclusief verlengingsopties. Aan het genoemde bedrag kunnen geen rechten worden ontleend. Voor opdrachtgever geldt geen afnameverplichting. Mocht gedurende de looptijd van de raamovereenkomst de maximale opdrachtwaarde worden overschreden dan zal de raamovereenkomst (eerder) worden beëindigd. Mercell Deze aanbesteding zal uitsluitend en geheel digitaal online worden afgehandeld via het Mercell platform (www.mercell.com). Een uitgebreide instructie met betrekking tot digitaal aanbesteden treft u aan in de Vragenlijsten.

title: Targeted Prostate Cancer Screening Programme - MRI Reporting Service
description:
The Contracting Authority is procuring a targeted prostate cancer screening pathway with a focus on men at increased risk due to an inherited BRCA2 variant utilising the competitive provider selection process under the Health Care Services (Provider Selection Regime) Regulations 2023.

NHS England is seeking a provider to deliver a national centralised Prostate MRI Reporting Service to support the Targeted Prostate Cancer Screening Programme for England.

The service will provide specialist reporting of prostate MRI examinations for Programme Participants requiring MRI following an above-threshold PSA result. The scope will include image receipt or access, case acceptance, specialist human double reporting, lesion delineation where required, expert arbitration, structured report production and authorisation, secure report return, acknowledgement and Failsafe arrangements, quality assurance, escalation, Programme data reporting, audit and governance participation.

Diagnostic MRI scanning is outside the scope of this procurement. The procurement also excludes PSA testing, biopsy delivery, urology treatment, BRCA digital decision-resource development, BRCA genetic testing and development of the national Programme IT system.

title: Targeted Prostate Cancer Screening Programme – PSA Laboratory Processing Service
description:
The Contracting Authority is procuring a targeted prostate cancer screening pathway with a focus on men at increased risk due to an inherited BRCA2 variant utilising the competitive provider selection process under the Health Care Services (Provider Selection Regime) Regulations 2023.

NHS England is seeking a provider to deliver a national Prostate Specific Antigen (PSA) Laboratory Processing and Virtual Screening Pathway Coordination service to support the Targeted Prostate Cancer Screening Programme for England.

The service will include PSA Sample logistics from the agreed collection handoff point, Sample receipt and accessioning, PSA processing and result authorisation, secure result transmission, consumables provision, Sample and pathway tracking, Failsafe management, Programme data and reporting, and Virtual Screening Pathway Coordination. The VSPC function will include coordination of MRI appointments following an above-threshold PSA result and coordination of biopsy/urology appointments following an actionable MRI result, within the Authority-approved pathway and responsibility arrangements.

The procurement does not include delivery of diagnostic MRI scanning or MRI reporting, biopsy procedures, urology treatment, BRCA digital decision-resource development, BRCA genetic testing or development of the national Programme IT system. Clinical delivery and acceptance of onward referrals remain with the relevant commissioned clinical providers.

title: Stage 2 -Amishku-Shipiss-Kigiap Konga - Beaver Brook Camp-Akami−Uapishkᵘ−KakKasuak−Mealy Mountains National Park Reserve
description: 5P468-26-0151/A Stage 2 -Amishku-Shipiss-Kigiap Konga - Beaver Brook Camp-Akami-Uapishk?-KakKasuak-Mealy Mountains National Park Reserve REQUIREMENT The Beaver Brook Camp project involves the complete construction of a camp facility located at the junction of Lake Melville and Etagaulet River, in Newfoundland and Labrador (Approx. coordinates are: 53°42'56.37"N 59°01'06.20"W). The Camp is comprised of 3 buildings, a Lodge (69m2 with a 34m2 screen porch and deck), a Privy (Backcountry Toilet, approx. 18m2) and a Cache (Storage Shed, approx. 25m2), all linked through wooden boardwalks (approx. 250m of boardwalks) and powered through solar panels. Tent Pads (five (5) total), a food cache, a seasonal floating dock, log benches, picnic tables, fire pit and a traditional camping site are also included in this project. Overall site work, tree clearing, topsoil preservation and re-naturalization, is required for this site. The site is remote with no existing infrastructure and is only accessible by boat, seaplane, helicopter or by snowmobile (during winter-pending safe ice conditions). TWO STAGE SELECTION PROCESS This posting is the Stage Two of a two-stage solicitation process: the first stage was to evaluate the qualifications of all interested suppliers. The second stage (Stage Two) is to invite the qualified suppliers to provide further qualifications and a financial bid on the project based on the specifications and drawings. Only qualified suppliers have been invited to bid. Potential and interested sub-contractors are invited to add their company’s name under the section “Partner with another business”

title: Terminal Process & Technology Modernization
description: Marine Atlantic Inc. Request for Proposals # 305-372-026 Terminal Process & Technology Modernization Marine Atlantic Inc. (“MAI”) invites offers from suppliers for Terminal Process & Technology Modernization. Marine Atlantic Inc. (“MAI”) is seeking a supplier to deliver a comprehensive set of services and deliverables across the Terminal Modernization Program. The Supplier will provide strategic, operational, technical, and infrastructure delivery services across five primary workstreams, aligned with the organization’s transition to a standardized, event-driven, and data-enabled terminal operating model. Marine Atlantic reserves the right to accept proposals in whole or in part.  The lowest or any proposal will not necessarily be accepted.   The closing for receipt of quotations will be 14:00 pm Atlantic Time, November 3rd, 2026. All documents related to the above noted procurement will only be available through the Merx electronic Bid Submission website. Proposals must be submitted by electronic means using the MERX EBS. This will be the only method of responses accepted for consideration. Proposals will not be considered if submitted by fax, email or other open forms of communication.   Proposals must be received by the closing date and time. Late proposals will not be considered. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Marine Atlantique S.C.C. Demande de propositions no 305-372-026 Modernisation des procédés et des technologies des terminaux Marine Atlantique S.C.C. (« MA ») invite les fournisseurs à présenter des offres pour la modernisation des procédés et des technologies de ses terminaux. Marine Atlantique S.C.C. (« MA ») est à la recherche d’un fournisseur capable d’offrir une gamme complète de services et de produits dans le cadre de son programme de modernisation des terminaux. Le fournisseur offrira des services stratégiques, opérationnels, techniques et liés aux infrastructures dans le cadre de cinq axes de travail principaux, en accord avec la transition de l’organisation vers un modèle normalisé d’exploitation des terminaux, axé sur les événements et fondé sur les données. Marine Atlantique se réserve le droit d’accepter des offres en tout ou en partie.  L’offre la plus basse ou toute autre offre ne sera pas nécessairement acceptée.   La date limite de réception des devis est fixée au 3rd Novembre 2026 à 14 h (heure de l’Atlantique). Les documents relatifs à l’approvisionnement décrit ci-dessus seront accessibles uniquement sur le site Web Merx d’envoi de soumission électronique. Les propositions doivent être envoyées au moyen de la fonction de soumission électronique sur MERX. Cette méthode de réponse est la seule acceptée. Les propositions soumises par télécopie, par courriel ou par d’autres formes ouvertes de communication, ne seront pas prises en considération.   Les propositions doivent être reçues avant la date et l’heure de clôture. Les propositions reçues après la date et l’heure limite ne seront pas prises en considération.  Bidding and Documents are available on http://www.merx.com. Fees may apply; See https://www.merx.com/public/pricing for more information.

title: Asbestos Abatement, Kejimkujik National Park and National Historic Site
description: 5P468-26-0262/A Asbestos Abatement, Kejimkujik National Park and National Historic Site BIDS RECEIVED BY FAX AND EMAIL WILL BE ACCEPTED AS OFFICIAL. PARKS CANADA IS NOT CURRENTLY ACCEPTING BIDS VIA SAP ARIBA, YOU MUST SUBMIT YOUR BID VIA FAX OR EMAIL AS INDICATED IN THE SOLICITATION DOCUMENT. BIDS RECEIVED IN-PERSON OR BY COURIER WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED. The only acceptable email address for responses to the bid solicitation is soumissionsami-bidsrpc@pc.gc.ca. Bids submitted by email directly to the Contracting Authority or to any email address other than soumissionsami-bidsrpc@pc.gc.ca will not be accepted. The only acceptable facsimile for responses to bid solicitations is 1-855-983-1808 (insert facsimile number). The maximum email file size that Parks Canada is capable of receiving is 15 megabytes. The Bidder is responsible for any failure attributable to the transmission or receipt of the emailed bid due to file size. The Bidder should be cognisant of the size of the email as a whole, and not only the attachments. Please take into consideration that some attachments, when sent, may be resized during the email transfer. If the email size is too large, the Bidder should send the bid in multiple emails properly labeled with the solicitation number, project name, and indicate how many emails are included (ex. 1 of 2). Emails with links to bid documents will not be accepted. Bid documents must be sent as email attachments. REQUIREMENT Parks Canada requires the following procedures for the removal of asbestos containing vermiculite insulation from the attic of seven (7) employee housing units located in Caledonia, Nova Scotia. The housing units are for the staff employed at Keji National Park and National Historic Site. To assist with bonding and insurance requirements, this project is estimated at a value between $100,001 > $250,000, Taxes extra. TWO-SUBMISSION BID This Bid shall be submitted following a “two-submission” procedure. Refer to SI03 of the Special Instructions to Bidders. CONTRACTOR SELECTION AND INDIGENOUS PARTICIPATION PLAN The Contractor should ensure provision of specific and agreed upon benefits for Indigenous People and Indigenous Businesses in the Area of the Contract. This Invitation to Tender contains bid criteria in order to provide socioeconomic benefits to Indigenous communities within the area covered by the contract. PERIOD OF CONTRACT / DELIVERY DATE Contractor must perform and complete the Work no later than November 30, 2026. OPTIONAL SITE VISIT It is recommended that the Bidder or a representative of the Bidder visit the work site. Arrangements have been made for the site visit to be held at 17 Spruce Street, Caledonia, NS B0T 0A7 on Tuesday November 3 2026. The site visit will begin at 10:00am AST. Bidders must communicate with the Contracting Authority no later than 48 hours before the site visit to confirm attendance and provide the name(s) of the person(s) who will attend. Bidders must also complete and submit a certification. Bidders who do not confirm attendance, provide the name(s) of the person(s) who will attend, or who do not complete and submit the above certification as required will not be allowed access to the site. Bidders will be requested to sign an attendance sheet. No alternative appointment will be given to bidders who do not attend or do not send a representative. Bidders who do not participate in the visit will not be precluded from submitting a bid. Any clarifications or changes to the bid solicitation resulting from the site visit will be included as an amendment to the bid solicitation. ENQUIRIES All enquiries of a technical and contractual nature are to be submitted to the Contracting Authority. Enquiries regarding this solicitation must be submitted in writing and should be received no later than five (5) calendar days prior to the date set for solicitation closing to allow sufficient time to provide a response. Enquiries received after that time may result in an answer NOT being provided. INFORMATION National Parks Regulations require that all work is to be performed in accordance with the ordinances, laws, rules and regulations set out in the National Park Act. Bidders that consider themselves qualified to provide this Work and intend to submit bids on this project should obtain documents from the Government Electronic Tendering Service through the Government of Canada tendering service at http://canadabuys.canada.ca/en/tender-opportunities. Addenda, when issued, will be available from the Government of Canada tendering service. Bidders that elect to base their bids on documents obtained from other sources do so at their own risk. Late submissions will not be considered. The Crown retains the right to negotiate with suppliers on any procurement. Documents may be submitted in either official language of Canada. Parks Canada has made every effort to provide equivalent documents in both official languages, however, if you find any discrepancies between the English and French documents, please notify the contract officer listed in this opportunity as soon as possible so that we can rectify the situation.

title: Request for Expression of Interest (RFEOI) to Dredge Jetty NE at CFB Halifax, NS
description: DEFENCE CONSTRUCTION CANADA (DCC) – Project No. HX253262_87645 – HAL-Maint Former Jetty NE Site Dkyd, CFB Halifax, NS Defence Construction Canada (DCC) invites general contractors to express their interest in providing all labour, materials, and equipment necessary to undertake contaminated marine dredging and infrastructure rehabilitation at Jetty NE, CFB Halifax, NS This Request for Expression of Interest (RFEOI) is the first step of a two-step solicitation process, the second step being the Tender Phase.  Only general contractors that have expressed their interest through the Electronic Bidding System prior to the closing date and time of this RFEOI will be invited to submit a proposal at the second stage. Only submissions received in accordance with the requirements of the Electronic Bidding System will be considered. Only the general contractors who will have responded to this RFEOI will be invited to submit a bid during the Tender Phase. DCC reserves the right to terminate this solicitation at the end of the RFEOI. As part of Canada’s commitment to maximize the participation of Indigenous Businesses, bidders are advised that this solicitation includes an Indigenous Benefits Plan (IBP). The Contractor will have to include Indigenous businesses (or eligible joint ventures) as subcontractors or suppliers to this project. Further details will be provided in the Tender phase. This solicitation is being conducted in accordance with the requirements set out in the Canadian Free Trade Agreement (CFTA), the Canada-European Union Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA) and the World Trade Organization Agreement on Government Procurement (WTO-GPA).   Project background A detailed project background can be reviewed in the Building Summary Documents Technical plans and specifications are not available during this RFEOI and will be provided during the Tender Phase; however, the Standard Construction Contract Documents for Electronic Bidding, DCL 250E, are available on DCC's website: https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/forms. Tenderers are advised that this contract is subject to DCC's Procurement Code of Conduct, which can be downloaded at https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/forms. A contractor or supplier who has been declared ineligible or suspended by Public Services and Procurement Canada under its Ineligibility and Suspension Policy and whose period of ineligibility or suspension may not have expired will not be able to proceed to the second stage. Bid security will be required during the Tender Phase in accordance with DCL193E- Instructions for Bidders for Electronic Bidding item 5. Estimate The Rough Order Magnitude estimate / Construction Cost Limit for this Contract is $26,834,000.00. This amount includes all construction costs, on-site work (including all required services, parking, and landscaping), site utilities, necessary redundant mechanical systems, communication conduits and wiring, backup power equipment, built-in equipment, built-in furniture, and inflation to achieve substantial completion. This amount excludes HST, design costs, travel and disbursements, consultant fees and expenses, movable equipment and furniture, IT equipment and contingencies. Schedule DCC will proceed with the Tender Phase around November 2026. The works shall reach substantial completion no later than 470 calendar days following the notification of contract award and shall be completed no later than 30 calendar days after the substantial completion date. Site visit No site visits will be offered during the RFEOI however, during the Tender Phase, bidders will be invited to a site visit. Access to information Act Tenderers are advised that DCC is subject to the provisions of the Access to Information Act (Canada). Information submitted may be eligible for disclosure in accordance with the requirements of the Act. Questions and clarifications Any questions or requests for clarification must be submitted in writing to DCC's Coordinator, Contract Services whose contact information can be found in the Electronic Bid System. DCC reserves the right to request clarification and/or confirmation regarding any aspect of this RFEOI to the Tenderer. In such a case, the Coordinator, Contract Services will be responsible for making the request. The request for clarification and/or confirmation will be sent to the contact person identified on the Electronic Submission System. Language of the Tender and the contract By submitting a response to this RFEOI, Tenderers will be invited to choose the desired official language for the tender documents and any resulting contract. In the Tender Phase, tender documents will be published in the language chosen by the Tenderer in the Electronic Bid System. Unless otherwise specified in the Contract, all Contract Documents to which the Contract applies or refers, as well as all deliverables, documents, reports and results of the work, services or goods that the Contractor submits, provides, or delivers to DCC or Canada in connection with the performance of the Contract, shall be in the language chosen by the Contractor on the Electronic Bid System. Joint venture A joint venture is an association of two or more parties that pools their funds, assets, knowledge, expertise, or other resources into a joint business venture, sometimes called a consortium, to bid together for a requirement. Tenderers submitting interest as a joint venture will be required to clearly indicate in the Electronic Submission System that they are forming a joint venture and should provide the following information: the name of the joint venture, if applicable, the name of the representative of the joint venture, i.e., the member chosen by the other members to represent them, if applicable, the name of each member of the joint venture. Security Requirements During Construction The Contractor will be required to hold, at all times during the performance of the construction contract, at least a valid Designated Organization Screening (DOS) or Facility Security Clearance (FSC) issued by Public Services and Procurement Canada's (PSPC) Contract Security Program (CSP). In the case of a joint venture, all parties to the joint venture must hold at least a valid Designated Organization Screening (DOS). DCC has issued an Advance Procurement Notice (APN) number BASE_APN_HX_2026_2027 to allow contractors that do not hold a valid Designated Organization Screening (DOS) security clearance / Facility Security Clearance (FSC) to initiate the sponsorship process prior to the launch of the tender phase. For information on the sponsorship process, consult the APN on MERX or visit https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/security-requirements. To be eligible to participate in the tender phase, a Tenderer who does not hold a valid Designated Organization Verification (DOS)/ Facility Security Clearance (FSC) security clearance will be required to: have submitted a Sponsorship application prior to the date of publication of the Tender phase (second step Tender Phase) as indicated in the Electronic Bidding System (MERX); meet all material requirements of the sponsorship application package by the closing date of the tender call (Tender phase) as indicated in the Electronic Bidding System (MERX); and Have submitted a response to this RFEOI. ” sponsorship application” means the activity of having completed the questionnaire on the DCC web page and having forwarded the answers to the DCC Industrial Security Program (ISP)”. ” sponsorship application package” means the activity of completing and forwarding the following forms to the DCC Industrial Security Program (ISP): the Application for Registration (AFR) for Canadian legal entities form, the Company Security Officer form, the Security Agreement form, the Security Clearance form, the Fingerprints Applicant form, the Alternate Company Security form and the Personnel Screeni

title: Psychologist Services - Newfoundland and Labrador
description: The Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP) require the services of a Registered Psychologist in Newfoundland and Labrador, for approximately 25 hours per week. The location of work is St. John’s, NL. The contract period will be for one year from the date of contract with an irrevocable option to extend it for up to two additional one-year periods. Policy on Reciprocal Procurement: This solicitation of bids is open only to Canadian suppliers. There is a Security Requirement associated with this contract. Basis of selection: To be declared responsive, a bid must: a. comply with all the requirements of the bid solicitation; and b. meet all mandatory technical evaluation criteria; and c. score between 0 and 30 points for the technical evaluation criteria which are subject to point rating. The rating is performed on a scale of 30 points. There is no minimum required. The selection will be based on the highest responsive combined rating of technical merit and price. The ratio will be 60% for the technical merit and 40% for the price Refer to the attached tender documents to obtain further information. Canada retains the right to negotiate with any supplier on any procurement. Documents may be submitted in either official language of Canada. Canada will make available Notices of Proposed Procurement (NPP), bid solicitations and related documents for download through the Government Electronic Tendering Service (GETS) at https://canadabuys.canada.ca/en/tender-opportunities . Canada is not responsible and will not assume any liabilities whatsoever for the information found on websites of third parties. In the event an NPP, bid solicitation or related documentation would be amended, Canada will not be sending notifications. Canada will post all amendments, including significant enquiries received and their replies, using GETS. It is the sole responsibility of the Bidder to regularly consult GETS for the most up-to-date information. Canada will not be liable for any oversight on the Bidder's part nor for notification services offered by a third party. The RCMP has adopted the Ineligibility and Suspension Policy administered by Public Services and Procurement Canada. As a result, the supplier integrity and compliance provisions are being applied in RCMP contracting activities as outlined in this solicitation. Indigenous Procurement: The federal Indigenous Business Directory (IBD) is an online resource for all levels of government and the private sector to identify Indigenous business capacity. Having a business profile in the IBD will increase your company’s visibility and may provide additional business. A profile in the IBD can also allow you to compete for federal government contracts that are set-aside for Indigenous businesses through the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Businesses. For more information and to review eligibility criteria and register, visit: www.canada.ca/indigenousbusinessdirectory.

description: Banedanmark ønsker at indgå en kontrakt med en driftsleverandør, som kan forestå den daglige, løbende drift af Banedanmarks svellefabrik beliggende Vejlbyvej 1, 7000 Fredericia og således ved brug af svellefabrikkens produktionsapparat producere og levere betonsveller i form af strækningssveller og sporskiftesveller, herunder svelletyper til særlige sporkonstruktioner såsom skinneudtræk ved broer, i forspændt beton til brug for Banedanmarks varetagelse af opgaven som jernbaneinfrastrukturforvalter. Produktionen sker efter long line-metoden. Driftsleverandøren skal i forbindelse hermed blandt andet: - Forestå en rationel og økonomisk forsvarlig produktion og levering af betonsveller af typerne Strækningssveller og Sporskiftesveller i overensstemmelse med kontraktens vilkår, - Som minimum opfylde kravene i DS/EN ISO 9001:2015 eller en tilsvarende standard for kvalitetsledelsessystem, jf. bilag 5 - Forestå kvalitetssikring af svelleproduktionen, - Løbende samarbejde med Banedanmark om en tilrettelæggelse af driften af Svellefabrikken, herunder deltage i samarbejdsmøder, - For egen regning indkøbe de nødvendige råvarer og materialer, der indgår i produktionen, i det omfang disse ikke i henhold til kontrakten er bygherreleverancer, som Banedanmark leverer, - Stille den nødvendige tekniske og administrative ekspertise til rådighed for driften af Svellefabrikken, herunder rådgive Banedanmark om udvikling og tilpasning af produktionen, - Bistå Banedanmark i forbindelse med ændringer af Svellefabrikken, herunder omstilling af produktionsapparatet med henblik på produktion af andre svelletyper, - Medvirke til en hensigtsmæssig tilrettelæggelse og gennemførelse af afhentningen af sveller fra fabrikken, herunder forestå læsning af sveller i forbindelse med transport af færdigproducerede sveller fra Svellefabrikken. For information om den historiske produktion af sveller henvises til bilag 17 til kontrakten. Driftsleverandøren forventes at overtage ansvaret for driften af svellefabrikken den 1.1.2028. Perioden fra den 1.9.2027 og forventeligt frem til den 31.1.2028 betragtes som en etableringsperiode. I denne periode samarbejder parterne tæt om hurtigst muligt at få etableret grundlaget for en stabil og effektiv drift af Svellefabrikken i overensstemmelse med kontraktens vilkår. Der henvises i øvrigt til Bilag 6, tidsplan for etablering. Den daglige ledelse af Svellefabrikken skal forestås af en fabrikschef. Fabrikschefen skal være ansat hos Driftsleverandøren (Banedanmarks kontraktpart). Kommunikationen mellem den af Driftsleverandøren antagne fabrikschef og Banedanmark skal foregå på dansk. Kontrakten er ikke til hinder for, at Banedanmark kan indkøbe sveller af tredjemand. Banedanmark er berettiget til at videresælge sveller til tredjemand. Lovbekendtgørelse nr. 710 af 20.8.2002 om lønmodtageres retsstilling ved virksomhedsoverdragelse med senere ændringer (Virksomhedsoverdragelsesloven) finder anvendelse i forbindelse med Driftsleverandørens overtagelse af ansvaret for driften af Svellefabrikken. De nærmere oplysninger herom fremgår af udbudsmaterialet. Ansøgere, som bliver prækvalificeret, vil have mulighed for at deltage i 2 fremvisninger af svellefabrikken. De konkrete datoer fremgår af tidsplanen i punkt 3 i udbudsbetingelserne.

title: Ny cykel- og gangbro ved Sønder Havn
description: Med lokalplan 1119 er der skabt grundlag for etablering af en supplerende bro, parallelt og nord for den eksisterende blå klapbro i Søndre Havn, der både muliggør en ombygning af den eksisterende bro og forbedrer trafiksikkerheden for cyklister og gående. På den baggrund inviterer Køge Kommune (Ordregiver) til projektkonkurrence om udarbejdelse af et konceptuelt stærkt og realiserbart idéoplæg for en ny gang- og cykelbro. Konkurrencen omfatter – udover indgivelse af ovennævnte idéoplæg - afgivelse af tilbud på de efterfølgende rådgivningsydelser, herunder projektering, udarbejdelse af udbudsprojekt samt byggeledelse og fagtilsyn i forbindelse med realiseringen af projektet. Udbuddet forventes gennemført i følgende faser. 1) Gennemførelse af prækvalifikation med udvælgelse af 3-5 deltagere 2) Fremsendte tilbudte idéforslag, som en del af tilbuddet, vurderes af en bedømmelseskomité på baggrund af bedømmelseskriterierne 3) Mulighed for indledning af forhandling med vinderen af projektkonkurrencen på baggrund af estimater, timepriser, CV’ere, udkast til tidsplan, mv. som udgør en del af tilbuddet.

title: Kansallismuseon näyttelykäyttöön tarkoitetut kohdevalaisimet sekä niihin liittyvät vaihdettavat optiikat
description: Kansallismuseon näyttelykäyttöön tarkoitetut kohdevalaisimet sekä niihin liittyvät vaihdettavat optiikat Hankinnan kohteena on Museoviraston / Kansallismuseon ("Hankintayksikkö") museon näyttelykäyttöön tarkoitetut kohdevalaisimet sekä niihin liittyvät vaihdettavat optiikat ja muut tarjouspyynnössä määritellyt lisävarusteet ("Tavara"). Hankittavien tuotteiden määrät ja tekniset vähimmäisvaatimukset on esitetty liitteenä olevassa valaisinluettelossa. Valaisimien tulee olla suoraan mekaanisesti ja sähköisesti yhteensopivia Kansallismuseon olemassa olevien ERCO 3-vaihevalokiskojen kanssa. Valaisimien runkomateriaalin tulee olla alumiinia. Valaisimiin tulee olla saatavana tarjouspyynnössä määritellyt vaihdettavat optiikat sekä värilämpötilaa lämpimämpään ja kylmempään suuntaan muuttavat suodattimet (Cold, Cold Plus, Warm ja Warm Plus tai vastaavat). Tavaralla tulee olla vähintään viiden (5) vuoden tuotetakuu. Takuu- ja huoltopalvelujen tulee olla saatavilla suomen kielellä. Tavara tulee toimittaa 29.1.2027 mennessä. Valituksi tulevan toimittajan tulee pyrkiä toimittamaan Tavara mahdollisimman pian sopimuksen tekemisen jälkeen ja mahdollisuuksien mukaan ennen määräaikaa. Tarkempi aikataulu sovitaan valitun toimittajan kanssa. Aikataulussa on huomioitava, että Tavaran toimitus tapahtuu museon avaamisprojektin aikana. Edellä mainitusta syystä Hankintayksikkö varaa oikeuden tarjouspyynnössä esitettyjen ajankohtien aikataulumuutoksiin. HUOM! 19.10.2026 Hankintayksikkö on korjannut korjausilmoituksella tarjouspyynnön liitettä. Hankintayksikkö on korjannut liiteessä "Kansallismuseo_näyttelyvalopaketti" solussa F10 olleen virheellisen lukuarvon. Uudessa liitteessä "Kansallismuseo_näyttelyvalopaketti korjaus" lukuarvo on korjattu. Lisäksi hankintayksikkö on korjauksesta johtuen pidentänyt kilpailutuksen määräaikaa sekä kysymysten jättämisen ja vastausten antamisen määräaikoja.,

title: Denmark – Architectural and related services – Ny cykel- og gangbro ved Sønder Havn
description: Med lokalplan 1119 er der skabt grundlag for etablering af en supplerende bro, parallelt og nord for den eksisterende blå klapbro i Søndre Havn, der både muliggør en ombygning af den eksisterende bro og forbedrer trafiksikkerheden for cyklister og gående. På den baggrund inviterer Køge Kommune (Ordregiver) til projektkonkurrence om udarbejdelse af et konceptuelt stærkt og realiserbart idéoplæg for en ny gang- og cykelbro. Konkurrencen omfatter – udover indgivelse af ovennævnte idéoplæg - afgivelse af tilbud på de efterfølgende rådgivningsydelser, herunder projektering, udarbejdelse af udbudsprojekt samt byggeledelse og fagtilsyn i forbindelse med realiseringen af projektet. Udbuddet forventes gennemført i følgende faser. 1) Gennemførelse af prækvalifikation med udvælgelse af 3-5 deltagere 2) Fremsendte tilbudte idéforslag, som en del af tilbuddet, vurderes af en bedømmelseskomité på baggrund af bedømmelseskriterierne 3) Mulighed for indledning af forhandling med vinderen af projektkonkurrencen på baggrund af estimater, timepriser, CV’ere, udkast til tidsplan, mv. som udgør en del af tilbuddet.

title: Denmark – Management-related services – Kontrakt om drift af Banedanmarks svellefabrik
description: Banedanmark ønsker at indgå en kontrakt med en driftsleverandør, som kan forestå den daglige, løbende drift af Banedanmarks svellefabrik beliggende Vejlbyvej 1, 7000 Fredericia og således ved brug af svellefabrikkens produktionsapparat producere og levere betonsveller i form af strækningssveller og sporskiftesveller, herunder svelletyper til særlige sporkonstruktioner såsom skinneudtræk ved broer, i forspændt beton til brug for Banedanmarks varetagelse af opgaven som jernbaneinfrastrukturforvalter. Produktionen sker efter long line-metoden. Driftsleverandøren skal i forbindelse hermed blandt andet: - Forestå en rationel og økonomisk forsvarlig produktion og levering af betonsveller af typerne Strækningssveller og Sporskiftesveller i overensstemmelse med kontraktens vilkår, - Som minimum opfylde kravene i DS/EN ISO 9001:2015 eller en tilsvarende standard for kvalitetsledelsessystem, jf. bilag 5 - Forestå kvalitetssikring af svelleproduktionen, - Løbende samarbejde med Banedanmark om en tilrettelæggelse af driften af Svellefabrikken, herunder deltage i samarbejdsmøder, - For egen regning indkøbe de nødvendige råvarer og materialer, der indgår i produktionen, i det omfang disse ikke i henhold til kontrakten er bygherreleverancer, som Banedanmark leverer, - Stille den nødvendige tekniske og administrative ekspertise til rådighed for driften af Svellefabrikken, herunder rådgive Banedanmark om udvikling og tilpasning af produktionen, - Bistå Banedanmark i forbindelse med ændringer af Svellefabrikken, herunder omstilling af produktionsapparatet med henblik på produktion af andre svelletyper, - Medvirke til en hensigtsmæssig tilrettelæggelse og gennemførelse af afhentningen af sveller fra fabrikken, herunder forestå læsning af sveller i forbindelse med transport af færdigproducerede sveller fra Svellefabrikken. For information om den historiske produktion af sveller henvises til bilag 17 til kontrakten. Driftsleverandøren forventes at overtage ansvaret for driften af svellefabrikken den 1.1.2028. Perioden fra den 1.9.2027 og forventeligt frem til den 31.1.2028 betragtes som en etableringsperiode. I denne periode samarbejder parterne tæt om hurtigst muligt at få etableret grundlaget for en stabil og effektiv drift af Svellefabrikken i overensstemmelse med kontraktens vilkår. Der henvises i øvrigt til Bilag 6, tidsplan for etablering. Den daglige ledelse af Svellefabrikken skal forestås af en fabrikschef. Fabrikschefen skal være ansat hos Driftsleverandøren (Banedanmarks kontraktpart). Kommunikationen mellem den af Driftsleverandøren antagne fabrikschef og Banedanmark skal foregå på dansk. Kontrakten er ikke til hinder for, at Banedanmark kan indkøbe sveller af tredjemand. Banedanmark er berettiget til at videresælge sveller til tredjemand. Lovbekendtgørelse nr. 710 af 20.8.2002 om lønmodtageres retsstilling ved virksomhedsoverdragelse med senere ændringer (Virksomhedsoverdragelsesloven) finder anvendelse i forbindelse med Driftsleverandørens overtagelse af ansvaret for driften af Svellefabrikken. De nærmere oplysninger herom fremgår af udbudsmaterialet. Ansøgere, som bliver prækvalificeret, vil have mulighed for at deltage i 2 fremvisninger af svellefabrikken. De konkrete datoer fremgår af tidsplanen i punkt 3 i udbudsbetingelserne.

title: Victim-offender mediation (VOM) services
description: An advanced contract award notice (ACAN) is a public notice indicating to the supplier community that a department or agency intends to award a contract for goods, services or construction to a pre-identified supplier, thereby allowing other suppliers to signal their interest in bidding, by submitting a statement of capabilities. If no supplier submits a statement of capabilities that meets the requirements set out in the ACAN, on or before the closing date and time stated in the ACAN, the contracting officer may then proceed with the award to the pre-identified supplier. 1. Definition of the requirement: Policy on Reciprocal Procurement: the Policy on Reciprocal Procurement does not apply to this procurement. The Correctional Service Canada (CSC) has a requirement to deliver post-sentence victim-offender mediation services to individuals impacted by serious crime (federally sentenced offences). The Contractor must provide services to victims residing in British Columbia and the Northern Territories (Yukon, Northwest Territories, & Nunavut), as well as to offenders who are incarcerated or on conditional release within these regions. This includes cross-regional cases where one participant is located within the region specified and the other is outside said region and supported by a mediator assigned to another region (Prairie, Ontario, Quebec, Atlantic). The work will involve the following: 1.1 Objective: To provide victim-offender mediation (VOM) services in accordance with the Victim-Offender Mediation Program (VOMP) model CSC has approved, based on the values and principles of restorative justice. The goal of delivering VOM services is to provide victims and offenders, in western Canada and the northern territories, the opportunity to communicate about and address the harms caused by the offence(s). The expected result is to prepare, facilitate, and assess safety throughout the restorative justice process between the participants and to meet their needs in areas of accountability, information sharing, increased understanding and empathy, healing, safety planning and the prevention of future harm. The Contractor must provide a minimum of two (2) qualified and professional victim-offender mediators to respond to all referrals requesting victim-offender mediation services involving offenders under CSC's jurisdiction. The mediators must collectively deliver approximately 3,500 hours of victim-offender mediation services annually to meet the following requirements: a. Deliver a combined minimum of 20 hours to a maximum of 80 hours per week of mediation services; b. Provide expertise, training and consultation on the Victim-Offender Mediation Program (VOMP) process model addressing serious crime with CSC’s Restorative Opportunities mediators, Restorative Justice Division, and CSC operational staff. c. Provide the level of expertise and mediation skills expected to complete victim-offender mediation processes, based on the VOMP process model, that include and are not limited to: i. Letter exchanges ii. Video exchanges iii. Shuttle mediation iv. Community conferencing v. Healing circles vi. Face-to-face meetings. 1.2 Tasks/Responsibilities: The Contractor must complete the following tasks that include, but are not limited to: 1. Forward all victim-offender mediation referrals received from CSC staff and contracted service providers working at the institutional and community level, from victims of crime, victim serving agencies, Parole Board Canada staff to the Restorative Justice Division at National Headquarters (NHQ) for initial review, creation of a case initiation form and Offender Management System (OMS) file creation in the Restorative Justice (RJ) Module. 2. Receive case referrals for victim-offender mediation services through CSC’s Restorative Justice Division, NHQ. 3. Assess all case referrals to determine their suitability for victim-offender mediation services. For cases deemed appropriate, the Contractor must prepare all participants for a victim-offender mediation process based on the participants needs and in accordance with VOMP process model. The contractor must begin with the participant that requested the service and only move on to the other participant if consent is given by the participant to proceed. 4. Perform ongoing assessments at each stage of the VOMP process and throughout service delivery to determine safety, security and confidentiality. 5. Maintain accurate and up to date records of all victim-offender mediation case activities by entering weekly updates in the RJ Module in OMS within 7 business days of the case activity taking place. 6. Participate in the annual Restorative Opportunities (RO) gathering and all other RO video conference calls, WebEx, MSTeams and Zoom meetings as requested by the Project Authority (PA). 1.3 Expected results: The Contractor must prepare, assess, and deliver post-sentence victim-offender mediation services addressing serious crime for voluntary victim and offender participants residing in British Columbia and the Northern Territories (Yukon, Northwest Territories, & Nunavut), as well as for cross-regional cases. The Contractor must provide Victims with the opportunity to tell the offender about the crime’s physical, emotional and financial impact on their lives, receive answers to lingering questions about the crime and the offender, and participate directly in developing options to address the participant’s needs and the harms caused by the crime(s). The offender is afforded opportunities to provide information, be held accountable, and to develop reparative plans and gain insight for personal growth. The Contractor must share information about the program and services provided and offer victim-offender mediation services through the Restorative Opportunities (RO) program. The purpose of CSC’s RO program is to assist individuals affected by serious crime by: a) Empowering them to address issues and concerns surrounding the crime and its consequences. b) Providing victims and offenders with a process that can lead to new insight about the offence, the harms caused, and actions that can be taken towards reparation and the prevention of future harms, thereby reducing levels of anxiety; and c) Addressing questions and concerns regarding the offender’s eventual release into the community. 1.4 Performance standards: 1.The following CSC laws, directives, guidelines and policies apply to the work: a. Corrections and Conditional Release Act, s.26.1(1) and (2) b. Commissioner's directive 785: Restorative opportunities and victim-offender mediation services c. Guidelines 785-1 : Restorative opportunities program protocols d. Canadian Victims Bill of Rights, s.6 e. Privacy Act f. Access to Information Act g. Witness Protection Program Act 2. The Contractor must complete all tasks and deliverables as per Commissioner’s Directive (CD) 785 Restorative Opportunities and Victim-Offender Mediation Services, as well as related protocols. 1.5 Deliverables: 1.5.1 The Contractor must provide the following deliverables to the Project Authority (PA): a. Accept and manage all case referrals, including a minimum of 25 newly referred cases per year, while continuing to work on all active cases carried over from previous years, as requested. b. Provide weekly updates in the OMS RJ Module for all active mediation files, including detailed documentation of all activities and any new and relevant information related to each file. c. Submit (1) one victim-offender mediation case study annually using the template and the consent form provided by the project Authority (PA). Deliverable Format 1. The Contractor must complete and provide all deliverable documents to the Project Authority (PA) using Microsoft Office software. 2. The Contractor must submit all deliverables in English; CSC will be responsible for any required translation. 3. The Contractor must complete ongoing updates the Restorative Justice (RJ) Module in OMS i

description: Amendement 001The RFI has been amended by:1. extending the Closing Date to November 10, 2026; and2. amending Form 1 – Response Submission Form in order to deal with the correct identification of this file. The remainder of the RFI document remains unchanged.SSC’s APM2 Industry DayShared Services Canada (SSC) would like to invite interested organizations to attend SSC’s APM2 Industry Day. This event will take place on November 2, 2026, from 2 to 3 p.m. ET.The APM2 Industry Day is being held in parallel with and relates to the Request for Information (RFI)for Application Performance Management 2 (APM2) Solution.If you are interested in attending this Industry Day, please provide the following information in an email to the following address: agnes.kowalska2@ssc-spc.gc.ca:• Subject: APM2 Industry Day• Company name• Attendee names and contact information• Accessibility requirements (if required)Deadline for registration is November 2, 2026 by 10:00 a.m. ET.Once you have registered for the APM2 Industry Day, you will receive a link to the meeting.If you have any questions regarding this event, please contact agnes.kowalska2@ssc-spc.gc.ca.We look forward to your participation.Request for Information (RFI) for Application Performance Management 2 (APM2) SolutionThe Government of Canada (GC) is seeking to modernize and optimize the Application Performance Management (APM) enterprise observability platform used to monitor the health and performance of GC IT infrastructure, application and datacentre observability. This Request for Information (RFI) aims to gather comprehensive insight from industry on all viable infrastructure and application performance observability platform solutions that support the continuous monitoring and tracking of infrastructure and application availability and performance while providing deeper ad-hoc visibility for diagnoses.The GC is seeking industry input on the current and emerging landscape with a view of informing future procurement strategies.  The objective is to establish procurement vehicle(s) that provide access to IT observability platform solutions and supporting services, to meet the Government’s diverse operational and security requirements.Through this initiative, the GC seeks to reduce risk, increase agility, and ensure long-term availability and performance of its IT infrastructure and application through observability.Please refer to the RFI Documentation for instructions on how to submit a Response.Questions: Questions concerning this RFI must be directed to the Contracting Authority. title: Uudet elintarvikealan kalusteet ja laitteet ammatilliseen koulutukseen
description: HANKINNAN TAUSTAA Koulutuskuntayhtymä OSAOn elintarvikealan koulutus siirtyy Haukiputaan toimipisteeseen osana tilojen uudistamista. Muutoksen yhteydessä rakennetaan ja varustellaan uudet elintarvikealan opetustilat, joihin hankitaan tarjouspyynnön mukaiset keittiölaitteet ja kalusteet. OSAO pyytää tarjouksia laitteista ja kalusteista tämän tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. HANKINNAN KOHDE Hankinnan kohteena ovat muun muassa : -keittopadat elintarviketilaan -RST-tasot, hyllyt, tekniikkaseinä -rasvapaistolaite leipomokäyttöön -vaihtolämpökaapit leipomokäyttöön -vesimittari leipomokäyttöön -pikapakastustunnelit elintarvikkeiden ja leipomotuotteiden jäähdytykseen ELINTARVIKEALAN OPETUSTILAT Elintarvikealan perustutkinnon opetusta annetaan kolmella osaamisalalla: elintarviketeknologia, liha-ala ja leipomoala. Elintarvikealan opiskelijat työllistyvät elintarviketeollisuuden työtehtäviin. Tilat toimivat tuotantokeittiöympäristönä, jossa valmistusprosessit ovat teollisen tuotannon kaltaisia ja käsiteltävät tuotantomäärät suuria. Tämän vuoksi laitteiden sijoittelun, mitoituksen ja yhteensopivuuden tulee mahdollistaa sujuva tuotantoprosessi. Tilakokonaisuus sisältää muun muassa seuraavat opetus- ja tuotantoalueet: -Liha- ja kalaosasto, jossa järjestetään liha- ja kala-alan opetusta sekä valmistetaan esimerkiksi makkaroita ja savustettuja tuotteita. -Konditoria- ja jäätelötila, jossa valmistetaan konditoriatuotteita sekä gelatoa. -Leipomo, jossa valmistetaan makeita ja suolaisia leipomotuotteita, kuten ruokaleipää. -Elintarviketilat, joissa suoritetaan elintarvikkeiden esikäsittelyä, valmistusta ja jatkojalostusta. Rakennettavissa opetustiloissa tapahtuu raaka-aineiden säilytys. Tuotantotiloissa tapahtuu raaka-aineiden esikäsittely, valmistus sekä kypsennys. Valmiit tuotteet jäähdytetään jäähdytystunneleissa, jonka jälkeen tuotteet pakataan ja siirretään välivarastoon. Välivarastosta on kuljetus myyntipaikkaan OSAOn Oppipuotiin. TOIMITUS- JA ASENNUSVASTUUT Haukiputaan toimipisteessä toteutetaan kiinteistön muutostyöt, joiden yhteydessä keittiötilat rakennetaan elintarvikealan opetuksen tarpeisiin. Vanhojen keittiölaitteiden ja koneiden purkamisesta sekä niiden uudelleenasennuksesta vastaa pääurakoitsija. Uusien tarjouspyynnön mukaisten laitteiden ja kalusteiden : keittopadat, vaihtolämpökaapit, rasvapaistolaite, pikapakastustunnelit, vesimittari, tekniikkaseinä, tasot, hyllyt ym. kalusteiden toimittamisesta ja asennuksesta vastaa laitetoimittaja yhteistyössä pääurakoitsijan kanssa. Kaikkien keittiölaitteiden ja koneiden lopullisista sähkö-, vesi-, viemäri- ja ilmanvaihtokytkennöistä vastaa pääurakoitsija. Pääurakoitsija vastaa keittiölaitteiden liitosjohdoista ja putkista. TOIMITUSAIKATAULU Toimitusten ja asennusten tulee tapahtua rakennusurakan aikataulun mukaisesti ja yhteistyössä tilaajan sekä pääurakoitsijan kanssa. Laitteet, kalusteet ja osissa toimitettavat pikapakastustunnelit tulee olla toimitettuna ja asennettuna viimeistään viikon 14 aikana, v. 2027. Tekniikkaseinä tulee olla toimitettuna ja asennettuna viimeistään viikolla 9, v.2027. Mikäli pikapakastustunnelit tulevat kokonaisena pakettina, tulee niiden toimitus ja asennus olla viimeistään viikolla 9, v.2027. Tarkemmat toimitusajankohdat sovitaan tilaajan kanssa erikseen. LAITTEIDEN MITOITUS JA YHTEENSOPIVUUS Kalusteiden ja laitteiden tulee vastata tarjouspyynnössä, piirustuksissa ja liiteasiakirjoissa esitettyjä vaatimuksia. Toimittaja vastaa tarjottujen laitteiden ja kalusteiden soveltuvuudesta sekä yhteensopivuudesta asennuspaikkaan. Tiloihin sijoitetaan sekä uusia että nykyisistä tiloista siirrettäviä laitteita ja kalusteita. Koska käytettävissä oleva tila on rajallinen, tarjottavien tuotteiden tule mahtua pohjapiirustuksessa ilmoitettuun paikkaan. Tarjouspyynnön liitteenä oleva Pohjapiirustus (liite 2) on viitteellinen suunnitelma. Osa-alueissa 1 ja 3 tarjoajan tulee liittää tarjouksensa liitteeksi oma keittiölaitesuunnitelma ja tekninen pohjapiirustus, jotka sisältävät kaikki tarjouspyynnön osa-alueissa hankittavat laitteet ja kalusteet. Suunnitelmassa tulee huomioida tilaajan olemassa olevat laitteet ja kalusteet. Suunnitelmissa uusien laitteiden ja kalusteiden tulee muodostaa olemassa olevien laitteiden ja kalusteiden kanssa toimiva ja tarkoituksenmukainen kokonaisuus. Pikapakastustunneleiden (osa-alue 2) osalta tarjoajan tulee liittää tarjouksensa liitteeksi erillinen suunnitelma ja tekninen pohjapiirustus, jossa esitetään mm. tunneleiden mitoitus ja sijoittelu. Näiden tulee olla yhteensopivat samaan tilaan tulevien kylmäsäilytystilojen kanssa, joiden rakentamisesta vastaa urakoitsija. Suunnitelman toimittamatta jättäminen johtaa tarjouksen hylkäämiseen tarjouspyynnön vastaisena. Pohjapiirustukset, kalusteluettelo ja muut tekniset tiedot ovat tarjouspyynnön liitteinä. SOPIMUSKAUSI JA TILAUSMÄÄRÄT Sopimuskausi alkaa, kun hankintasopimus on allekirjoitettu, ja jatkuu siihen saakka, kunnes kaikki sopimuksen mukaiset velvoitteet on asianmukaisesti täytetty. Hankinnalle on varattu määräraha, jonka puitteissa hankinta toteutetaan. Tilausmäärät voivat vaihdella määrärahan puitteissa. SELONOTTONEUVOTTELUT Hankinnasta pidetään ennen hankintapäätöksen tekemistä selonottoneuvottelut. Selonottoneuvottelujen alustava ajankohta on 27.11.2026 ja ne pidetään joko Teamsilla tai osoitteessa Kotkantie 1, Oulu. Kaikilla kiinnostuneilla toimittajilla on ollut mahdollisuus tutustua materiaaliin ja esittää siihen kommentteja määräaikaan mennessä. Saadut kommentit on huomioitu tarjouspyynnön valmistelussa hankintayksikön harkinnan mukaan., Keittopadat, tekniikkaseinä, RST tasot, hyllyt ja muut kalusteet Osa-alue 1 sisältää: -Uudet keittopadat OSAOn elintarvikealan opetustiloihin. Patoja hankitaan 2kpl ja niiden tulee olla samanlaisia, ns. patapari. Padat ovat pinta-asennettuja, vapaasti seisova malli, ryhmään asennus. LVIS kytkennät tehdään patoihin yhteistyössä pääurakoitsijan kanssa. -Uudet RST-tasot, hyllyt ja tekniikkaseinä OSAOn elintarvikealan opetustiloihin.
